theme: योग से भटकना, फिर पुण्य के फल से अनुकूल पुनर्जन्म / Falling from yoga, then receiving a favorable rebirth through past merit.
context: Krishna has just told Arjuna that a sincere aspirant who fails in practice is not lost forever. A fallen yogi is not discarded; the verse says he may first receive the fruits of past merit in a higher realm and then return in a more favorable birth. This is about continuity, not cancellation.
contextHindi: भगवान ने अभी बताया है कि योग का अभ्यास छोड़ देने वाला साधक सदा नष्ट नहीं होता। अगर कोई योग से गिर जाए, तो भी वह समाप्त नहीं होता; उसके लिए पुण्य के फल और फिर अनुकूल जन्म की संभावना बनी रहती है। यह निराशा नहीं, बल्कि आगे उठने की राह है।
sanskritDevanagari:
प्राप्य पुण्यकृतां लोकानुषित्वा शाश्वतीः समाः |
शुचीनां श्रीमतां गेहे योगभ्रष्टोऽभिजायते ||६-४१||
transliteration:
prāpya puṇyakṛtāṃ lokānuṣitvā śāśvatīḥ samāḥ .
śucīnāṃ śrīmatāṃ gehe yogabhraṣṭo.abhijāyate ||6-41||

wordByWord.meaning: of those who did meritorious acts; the people of punya
for many eternal years; a long period
in the house / in the family
one fallen from yoga; one who lost touch with yogic discipline
is born again; comes into rebirth

spokenHindi: यह श्लोक समझाता है कि योग का रास्ता कभी भी पूरी तरह निरर्थक नहीं जाता। अगर कोई साधक योग में गिर जाए, तो वह सिर्फ समाप्त नहीं होता; वह पुण्य के लोकों में जाता है, वहाँ बहुत समय तक रहता है, और फिर शुचि, संयम और उच्चता वाले परिवार में जन्म लेता है। यह श्लोक डर नहीं, बल्कि धैर्य देता है। यह बताता है कि गिरना ही अंतिम सत्य नहीं है। जो मन में साधना का बीज रखा है, वह जीवन-रूप से भी फिर उठ सकता है। इसलिए अगर आप अभ्यास में दरार महसूस करें, तो इस श्लोक का अर्थ है—अवसर मिलते रहेंगे, लेकिन आगे बढ़ने की निष्ठा चाहिए। योग का पतन केवल बाहरी असफलता नहीं, बल्कि फिर से सही दिशा में लौटने का संकेत भी हो सकता है।
clearEnglish: This verse is not a promise of easy success, but a promise of continuity. Krishna says that a person who has fallen from the yogic path is not erased by that fall. He may first dwell in the worlds of the righteous, where the effects of past merit are worked out, and then be born into a clean, cultured, or materially stable household. The point is not that family background magically guarantees liberation; rather, a more favorable environment can support renewed effort. The verse affirms a moral order: the inner intention does not vanish simply because practice is interrupted. A realistic lesson is that setbacks are part of the human path, but they are not the final verdict on a person’s spiritual potential.

interpretationPerspectives.label: TEXT
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The verse literally says one who has fallen from yoga is born again in a house of the pure and prosperous after dwelling in the worlds of the meritorious. It does not say a person is permanently condemned for a single lapse.

interpretationPerspectives.label: COMMENTARY
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: The Divine Life Society summary reads this as a rebirth with more favorable conditions for sadhana, not as a punishment. That is a practical interpretation, not a literal statement of divine sentence against a person.

interpretationPerspectives.label: INFERENCE
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: A spiritually significant effort is not erased by temporary disorientation. Life conditions may help or hinder practice, but the inward seed of effort can carry forward.

interpretationPerspectives.label: CUSTOM
interpretationPerspectives.explanation: Families differ in how they value discipline, purity, and spiritual practice. This verse is not a decree that one family form is universally superior or that wealth or lineage automatically makes one a yogi.

practicalApplication.label: Reset without shame
practicalApplication.text: If your meditation has become irregular, do not treat that as a spiritual failure. Resume a smaller, clearer practice today: five minutes of breath awareness, one honest review of distractions, and one act of integrity.

reflectionQuestion: If a sincere effort wavers, what does this verse suggest about compassion, patience, and the possibility of returning to the path?
reflectionQuestionHindi: अगर कोई earnest साधना में डगमगाए, तो इस श्लोक से सहानुभूति, धैर्य और मार्ग पर लौटने की संभावना के बारे में क्या सीख मिलती है?
